<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a craft-able crafting material, obtainable by refining wood. It is one of the few crafting materials that has multiple qualities, presumably for a variety of purposes.

As of v1.404, it is implemented, and 4 silver quality pieces are used for the construction of the  [[Soul container III (Base)]].
